join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list addb mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' added, restricted to broadcasters and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list addb mylist2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist2' added, restricted to broadcasters and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add Something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Something" has been added to the list as item #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add Other thing
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Other thing" has been added to the list as item #2.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list rename
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !list rename <old> <new>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list rename mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !list rename <old> <new>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list rename mylist mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mylist' is already called 'mylist'!

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list rename mylist mylist2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] A command or list with name 'mylist2' already exists.


handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=moderator :!list rename mylist other
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Your level is moderator; you cannot rename a list with level broadcaster.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list rename mylist other
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' has been renamed to 'other'.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!other get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Something

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!other get 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Other thing

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist get 1
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list rename what other
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'what' does not exist.
